Platform captions · Individual reviews

Your video.
Your final say.

Level13 Publisher helps its owner send original videos from a private Telegram conversation to connected YouTube and TikTok accounts and a Telegram channel.

01 / YouTube

Review your Shorts upload

Provide a title and master caption, then review the generated YouTube description. Accept submits that version using the configured visibility. Check YouTube Studio for processing, Shorts classification, and the final publication result.

Open YouTube Studio

02 / TikTok

Choose your publishing settings

When Direct Post is configured and authorized, Accept opens a private publishing form. Review the video and caption, choose privacy and interaction settings, complete disclosures, and select Publish.

TikTok access depends on app permissions and platform approval. Private testing remains restricted to Only me.

03 / Telegram

Publish to your channel

Review the channel caption and video in your private bot chat. Accept publishes that version to the configured channel, where the bot must have administrator permission to post.

From Telegram to your accounts

  1. 01Send a videoChoose active platforms, upload a video, and reply with its title and master caption. OpenRouter adapts the text for each destination.
  2. 02Review each versionReceive one video preview per active platform. Accept it, or replace that platform’s caption or video. A replacement continues the publishing sequence.
  3. 03Publish independentlyEach destination has its own approval and status. TikTok requires its final settings form. A transfer receipt does not guarantee public visibility.

Private access. This is an owner-operated tool, with no public registration or uploads on this website. Platform access depends on authorization, review, and account limits.
